body: I should have thought of this on my last request, but I'm now worried that ZSH users will try to use these symbols and get confused when they don't work. Could we add a [warning](https://v1.vuepress.vuejs.org/guide/markdown.html#custom-containers) here that notes that the new additions only work with Fish shell due to upstream issues with ZSH? We could even link the relevant issue, if you think it would be informative.
